“They need a #MeToo moment,” said Rep. Jackie Speier, who has been critical of the treatment of women in the male-dominated FBI.

“It’s repugnant, and it underscores the fact that the FBI and many of our institutions are still good ol’-boy networks,” Speier said.

@joan_mediator This has been a long term problem at that agency. The FBI is stuck in the 20th Century, and not the good parts of it. Good to see Rep. Jackie Speier say a focus on #MeToo is needed at the FBI.
Changing the FBI management’s coverup culture is necessary to address #MeToo sexual misconduct and #whistleblower retaliation.
